title: Frankenstein 1831 frontispiece
alt: Black-and-white engraving of Victor Frankenstein recoiling as the creature lies newly animated beside laboratory equipment.
caption: Theodor von Holst's frontispiece to the 1831 edition of Frankenstein.
teachingUse: Separates the cultural imagination of catastrophic creation from later probabilistic and technical risk arguments.
